_about: Bin colours councils publish but don't put in their collection data, keyed by GSS code. Used only when the council's own bin name has no colour; a resident's choice always wins. One entry per council: category -> colour (blue, black, green, brown, grey, purple, red, yellow), plus where it came from. "options": {category: [colours]} when the council uses one of a few colours for that bin depending on the street; we then ask the resident to choose only between those.
